tools.name: search
tools.description: AwesomeFee — TRON resources for AI agents. Free. Finds what you need on TRON — e.g. "send USDT without TRX", "buy energy", "TRON RPC node", "events webhook" (English or Russian) — and returns catalogue entries: id, title, description, method, url, parameters (JSON Schema of the body), price, payment

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: search · Public sink: search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: search · Public sink: search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
